subject: Next steps and schedule: VP intro + technical deep-dive — NexMart discovery recap
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@nexmart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: NexMart discovery — recommended next steps + proposed exec intro slots

Hi Amelia — thanks again for the intro call earlier today. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Key pain: unpredictable inference costs and inconsistent latency for peak retail traffic (Black Friday spikes called out).
- Primary objectives: 1) control unit economics for recommendations pipeline, 2) reduce p95 latency to <120ms for 8k daily concurrent shoppers, 3) PCI/PII audit readiness for checkout data.

Action items I propose: 
1) VP/CTO intro (~30m) to align exec priorities and procurement timeline — target attendees: Francisco (VP Product) / Carlos (CTO).
2) Technical deep-dive (~60m) with engineering + infra to map current pipeline, quantify throughput, and review our Dedicated/Private options. Vivek would lead.
3) Share a short infra checklist and SOW draft ahead of the deep-dive.

Please see the attached discovery notes for call highlights (nexmart_discovery_notes_20260224.pdf).

Availability: to surface exec availability I can do the following slots next week (PT):
- Wed 02/25 08:30–09:00 
- Thu 02/26 16:00–16:30
- Fri 02/27 09:00–09:30

For the deep-dive (technical) Vivek is available: Thu 02/26 10:00–11:30 or Fri 02/27 11:00–12:00 (we can shift if needed).

If you can confirm one exec time that works for Carlos, I’ll send calendar invites and the prep doc.

Thanks — happy to adjust.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachment: nexmart_discovery_notes_20260224.pdf (summary, 3 pages)

From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@nexmart.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@nexmart.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NexMart discovery — recommended next steps + proposed exec intro slots

Hi Neha — thanks for the thorough recap and notes. Carlos and I reviewed the summary internally. A couple quick answers/questions before we lock times: 

- Carlos can join the exec intro but prefers mornings PT and asks that you include a 5–10 minute overview of cost projections vs current spend.
- Our VP Product (Francisco Alvarez) is traveling but can make Tue/Thu mornings next week. Carlos proposes Thu 02/26 09:00 PT, would that work for you/neha?
- For the technical deep-dive: Carlos wants the infra checklist beforehand and prefers that network/security is part of the conversation. Who from Redwood would join for security questions?

Also cc'ing our procurement lead in-thread (I’ll loop formally if we get to pricing/POC).

Thanks,
Amelia
Director of Engineering Programs | NexMart Retail
amelia.torres@nexmart.com
+1 (206) 555-8822

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NexMart discovery — recommended next steps + proposed exec intro slots

Neha — quick internal note. If Amelia/CTO want security on the tech call, please include Rafael from Security (I’ll loop him if we need SOC/architecture detail). Vivek, can you confirm which of the following you can bring and whether the 02/27 deep-dive slot is still open?

Requested on deep-dive: quantized model performance, expected throughput on Dedicated, KV cache strategy, network egress assumptions, and our SOC2 artifact timeline.

Marissa
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@nexmart.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NexMart discovery — recommended next steps + proposed exec intro slots

Hi Amelia/Neha — Vivek here (Engineering, Redwood). Happy to lead the technical session. I’ll bring:
- Benchmarks for comparable retail recommendation workloads (p95/p99 and token cost estimates)
- Dedicated deployment sizing guidance and quantization options
- A short network/security slide explaining VPC onboarding and audit logs (Rafael will join if they want SOC2 specifics)

Proposed deep-dive windows (PT):
- Thu 02/26 10:00–11:30 (90m) — preference A
- Fri 02/27 11:00–12:00 (60m) — preference B (can expand to 90m if you need more time)

I attached a lightweight infra checklist to help your infra team prepare (redwood_infra_checklist_v3.xlsx). For planning, I created a starter SOW outline; we can adjust after the deep-dive (nexmart_sow_initial_20260227.docx).

Let me know which exec slot Amelia confirms and we’ll get invites and prep materials out.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood_infra_checklist_v3.xlsx

From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@nexmart.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@nexmart.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NexMart discovery — recommended next steps + proposed exec intro slots

Neha, Vivek — thanks for the quick turnaround. Carlos accepts Thu 02/26 09:00 PT for the exec intro; he’ll step off after 25–30 minutes. Francisco (VP Product) can join remotely as well. For the deep-dive we’ll take Vivek’s Thu 02/26 10:00–11:30 slot — Rafael from our security team will join for the 10:20–10:40 security segment you suggested. 

Two small asks before the deep-dive: 
1) Can you add a 1-slide cost-projection (expected unit spend delta vs our current setup) in the exec deck? Carlos wants this to justify moving to a pilot.
2) Please share any onboarding prerequisites (network allowlists, sample test tokens, expected SLA for pilot).

I’ll confirm procurement contact and whether we need an NDA attached to the SOW; otherwise this looks good. Looking forward to the sessions.

Best,
Amelia
